summary: Iteration 46 - Validated P2+P3 quality batch: lifespan migration, cancel_job 404/400/200 differentiation, /api/ai-evaluation/health endpoint, SSE json.dumps safety, new 'monitor-procesos' manual + updated 'api-integraciones' manual with 'Monitoreo de workers' section, and Dashboard.css extraction. Backend 12/13 pytest pass (1 skip due to no En_Cola jobs available in env). Frontend all flows green: login, Dashboard .lm-dashboard class + computed styles applied (no FOUC), /manuales lists 9 manuals incl. monitor-procesos with all 4 required sections, /monitor lazy loads table+filters, /documentation all 3 tabs render. Zero console errors during testing.

minor.issue: Response envelope is {data: [...], total, page, pages} — standardize vs. /api/manuals which is {data: [...], total} (no page/pages) and /api/journeys which is {data: [...], pagination}. Three different pagination shapes across listing endpoints — consider a single common envelope.

Could not exercise DELETE on En_Cola job because queue has 0 jobs in En_Cola state (worker drained or saturated by stuck Evaluando). Logic path is same code as 400/404 branches so covered by code review; runtime cover test SKIPPED.

action_items: (INFO) DELETE /api/ai-evaluation/jobs/{id} 200 path not runtime-covered — enqueue a new job before cancellation to exercise end-to-end in future runs (test already ready, just needs seeded En_Cola job).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py lifespan migration is clean: @asynccontextmanager with startup (_create_indexes, _auto_migrate_order_id, start_kosmo_sync, start_ai_eval_worker) and shutdown (stop_kosmo_sync, stop_ai_eval_worker) properly wired via FastAPI(lifespan=lifespan). No deprecation warnings observed in backend logs.

ai_eval_routes.cancel_job: 404 vs 400 differentiation is implemented correctly — 404 for missing job_id, 400 with explicit 'actual: <status>' detail for wrong state. Single f-string detail uses single quotes around status properly.

ai_eval_routes.worker_health: status branching logic is ordered correctly (saturated first, stuck second, healthy default). oldest_running_age_seconds derived via datetime.fromisoformat with 'Z'->'+00:00' normalization + try/except on ValueError/TypeError — robust.

ai_eval_routes.stream_job: json.dumps used for both error payload and progress payload — confirmed via SSE test that 'data: ...' parses cleanly as JSON. Good replacement for f-string dict interpolation.

manual_routes: new monitor-procesos manual has all 4 required sections (Estados, Filtros, Acciones, Arquitectura); api-integraciones updated with 'Monitoreo de workers' section referencing /api/ai-evaluation/health — confirmed in DB and via UI render.
Dashboard.jsx -> Dashboard.css extraction: .lm-dashboard class present at runtime, computed styles applied (display:flex), no FOUC observed. Extraction reduces JSX line count as promised.
(Pre-existing, orthogonal) No max_length validator on comentario_asesor in IncidentBase — still carried over from iter-44/45 findings.

success_rate.backend: 92% (12/13 pass, 1 skipped due to env - 0 failures)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (login, dashboard CSS, manuals, monitor-procesos sections, monitor page, documentation tabs)

Listing endpoints use different pagination envelope keys — use the _extract_list() helper (checks data/items/jobs/results).
